chunks: Y un grupo me informó por medio de Abū Muḥammad Hārūn ibn Mūsā al-Ṭalʿkabarī, quien dijo: Me informó Abū ʿAlī Aḥmad ibn ʿAlī, conocido como Ibn al-Khaḍīb al-Rāzī, quien dijo: Me narraron algunos de nuestros compañeros de Hanzala ibn Zakarīyā al-Tamīmī, de Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā al-Ṭūsī, de Abū Bakr ʿAbdullāh ibn Abī Shaybah, de Muḥammad ibn Fudayl, de al-Aʿmash, de Abū Ṣāliḥ, de Ibn  ʿAbbās, quien dijo:

Ya'qub ibn Sufyan narrated: Jibraeel (peace be upon him) descended with a scroll from Allah to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), in which were twelve seals of gold. He said to him: 'Surely, Allah the Exalted sends you greetings and commands you to deliver this scroll to the noble one from your family after you. He will break the first seal and act according to what is in it. When he passes away, he will deliver it to his successor after him. Thus, the first will deliver it to the last, one after another.' The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) did as he was ordered. Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) broke the first one and acted according to what was in it, then delivered it to al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who broke his seal and acted according to what was in it. He delivered it after him to al-Husayn (peace be upon him), then al-Husayn delivered it to Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him), and so on, one after another, until it reaches the last of them (peace be upon them all).
ai.seo_question: ¿Cuál es el hadiz sobre los doce sellos dorados transmitidos del Profeta a los Imames?
ai.summary: Esta narración de Ibn Abbás, citada por Al-Tusi en *Kitab al-Ghayba*, proporciona una validación de la cadena suní (isnad) para la doctrina de los Doce Imames, enmarcando su sucesión como un mandato divino entregado mediante un pergamino con doce sellos dorados. Enfatiza la naturaleza secuencial y hereditaria del Imamato, donde cada Imam desbloquea la siguiente etapa de autoridad, culminando en el Imam final, reforzando así el concepto de *Nass* (designación) dentro de la teología chií.
